description: Mutants of the trace Module and the Base trace facade (docs/architecture/target/v2/trace-declaration.zh-Hant.md; Design Invariants in target/v2/trace.zh-Hant.md). Each mutant replaces one exact text; killed only when the run fails and its output matches expect.

mutants.what: D2: a span ended by an exception unwinding it is reported as ended normally
mutants.cases: trace facade: a span ended by an exception unwinding it*
mutants.expect: ERROR: CHECK\( installed\.log\.events == std::vector<std::string>\{"begin kernel Main ", "end 1 exception"\} \)

mutants.what: D2: the unwinding count is not taken at Begin, so a span begun during an unwinding is reported as ended by it
mutants.cases: trace facade: a span begun and ended inside a destructor*
mutants.expect: D2: only an unwinding that started after Begin marks the span

mutants.what: D2: a span ends at whatever receiver is installed now instead of the one it began with
mutants.replace: if (receiver_ != nullptr) if (const TraceReceiver* now = Detail::traceReceiver.load()) now->end(token_, std::uncaught_exceptions() > exceptions_);
mutants.cases: trace facade: a span ends at the receiver it began with*
mutants.expect: ERROR: CHECK\( installed\.log\.events == std::vector<std::string>\{"begin kernel Main ", "end 1"\} \)

mutants.what: D2: a second Begin starts the span again (two begins, one end)
mutants.cases: trace facade: a second Begin*
mutants.expect: D2: one span, one begin and one end

mutants.what: TR-4: a span's parent is not the span below it on this thread
mutants.cases: trace: nested spans become one record each*
mutants.expect: TR-4: the parent is the span below on this thread

mutants.what: TR-5: duration_ns is not the time since begin
mutants.cases: trace: nested spans become one record each*
mutants.expect: TR-5: duration_ns is the time since begin

mutants.what: D4 (i): an error marked where it is produced writes no path
mutants.cases: trace: an error marked where it is produced*
mutants.expect: D4 \(i\): one path record where the error is produced

mutants.what: D4 (i): an error that only passes through also writes a path (one path per layer)
mutants.cases: trace: an error that only passes through*
mutants.expect: D4 \(i\): passing through writes no path

mutants.what: D4 (i): every span an exception unwinds writes a path, not only the first
mutants.cases: trace: spans unwound by an exception*
mutants.expect: D4 \(i\): the first span the exception unwinds is the origin

mutants.what: D2: TraceMarkCurrent marks the bottom of the stack instead of its top
mutants.cases: trace: TraceMarkCurrent marks*

mutants.what: TR-6: a span is timed even when no sink takes its record
mutants.cases: trace: with only span.path taken*
mutants.expect: TR-6: a span no sink takes reads no clock

mutants.what: D5: with no Logger installed records count as taken (they would go to standard error)
mutants.cases: trace: with no Logger installed*
mutants.expect: D5: with no Logger no span is timed

mutants.what: TR-4: a stack left by an earlier Install is not emptied (its spans sit under the new ones)
mutants.cases: trace: a span begun under an earlier Install*
mutants.expect: TR-4: the old span left nothing on the new stack

mutants.replace: for (std::size_t i = index; i + 1 < stored && false; ++i) {
mutants.cases: trace: a span ended while another is on top*
